rule_name: Null sensor value on the critical path
Non-positive sensor reading (physically impossible)
Process temperature below air temperature (sensor swap)
Non-positive torque or speed
Failure logged against an unknown machine
Telemetry for an unknown machine
Machines with an incomplete hourly series
Duplicate machine-hour readings
Readings beyond 5 sigma from the fleet mean
Run flagged with a mode but no machine-failure flag
Failures with no component replacement within 6h
Failure flag set with no failure mode labelled
Machines with zero failures in the window
Machine-days with zero sensor variance (stuck transmitter)
Failure timestamps outside the telemetry window
Telemetry readings ingested
Process runs (AI4I feed)
Error events
Maintenance events
Failure events
Machines instrumented
